title: Galderma to snap up California-based ZO Skin Health for USD 1.5 billion
summary: Swiss skincare group Galderma announced on Wednesday, October 14, that it has agreed to acquire California-based ZO Skin Health for an enterprise value of USD 1.5 billion (EUR 1.3 billion), strengthening its position in medical skincare. title: Jean-Marc Bellaiche, ex PDG du Printemps, aux commandes de Douglas
summary: Le groupe Douglas a nommé Jean-Marc Bellaiche au poste de directeur général, à compter du 1er novembre 2026. title: Former Printemps CEO Jean-Marc Bellaiche takes the helm at Douglas
summary: Germany-based Douglas Group has appointed Jean-Marc Bellaiche as Chief Executive Officer, effective 1 November 2026. The former Printemps chief will succeed Sander van der Laan, who is retiring after a 36-year career in retail, including four years leading the European premium beauty retailer. Bellaiche's appointment has been approved for a four-year term by the supervisory board of Douglas AG. The 56-year-old French executive brings extensive experience in luxury, beauty and retail. title: Shiseido takes Shein to court in EUR 2.6 million distribution dispute
summary: Shiseido is seeking more than EUR 2.6 million in damages from online retail giant Shein over the sale of its beauty products outside its authorized distribution network. The case could prove a landmark test of selective distribution agreements amid the rise of global e-commerce platforms. title: Shiseido demande 2,6 millions d'euros à Shein pour concurrence déloyale
summary: Shiseido réclame plus de 2,6 millions d'euros au géant du commerce en ligne Shein pour avoir commercialisé des produits de beauté sans faire partie de son réseau de revendeurs agréés.
